method: Automated command-only campaign run: ordinary gather/build/queue/attack-move, no teleports, injected damage, resources, or objective completion. This is a mechanical feasibility test, not human average-player certification.

results.title: The Bridge at Dawn
results.result: The villages have escaped and the Emperor has retreated through his crossing, leaving his shed tail behind. The containment crew seals the foreign tissue. The invasion has been checked, but the barrier between worlds is already weakening.

results.title: Imperial Orders
results.result: The imperial foothold is secure, but its repeated crossings are making the boundary unstable. Wizard scouts are closing on the apparatus that controls the breach.

results.title: Keys to a Third World
results.result: The researchers have steadied the apparatus, not repaired the boundary. Morvane is now connected to the war. Refugees from the first invasion are gathering at Ashbridge while fighting spreads into the third world.

results.title: Through the Breach
results.result: The residents have reached the compound. Morvane's old rivalries now have roads into other worlds. Back in Kareth, Human commanders can no longer treat the imperial invasion as a distant conflict.

results.title: No Neutral Ground
results.result: The frontier supply routes are open. Human and Machine forces have cooperated on this front, but the wider war continues. In Elyndra, a new imperial offensive is approaching Ashbridge.

results.title: Hold Ashbridge
results.result: The evacuation has cleared Ashbridge. The infirmary must be abandoned, along with its stored specimens. What happens to one small glass chamber belongs to the refugees' story.

results.title: Lines in the Earth
results.result: The Queen Chamber and its supply district have survived. The colony has defended its independence, while industrial supply roads carry the war into Primate forests.

results.title: The Forest War
results.result: The military convoys have been intercepted and the crossing secured. Primate communities have kept control of this route. Elsewhere, the Machines are rebuilding the factories that sustain their war.

results.title: Logic of War
results.result: Machine coordination is restored and the siege is broken. To the refugees passing those factories, such order offers a striking contrast to the war. Elyndra's mountain peoples still fight to keep their own supply roads open.

results.title: Stone and Oath
results.result: The temple and its supply routes are secure. Local oaths have held this alliance together. Beyond the mountains, Draconic hatcheries face an industrial offensive of their own.

results.title: Fire Against Steel
results.result: The hatchery has survived and the assault depot is gone. Air power alone could not save it: supplies and ground defenses mattered. In Morvane, rivals continue fighting for access to the crossings.

results.title: The Terms of Fire
results.result: The crossing remains open, but no power controls the widening war. Among the refugees, Thread has left its box. Imperial investigators are now reopening records of the first battle.

results.title: The Emperor's Wound
results.result: The records trace the contamination to the Emperor's discarded tail, living regenerative tissue, fungus and foreign magic. The specimen is missing. Across Kareth, reports of unexplained biological activity are beginning to arrive.

results.title: Unaccounted Movements
results.result: The supply column is safe, but the patrol reports confirm an unfamiliar biological force. Other communities tell a different story: organisms that offer food, shelter and healing.

results.title: Shelter of the Unclaimed
results.result: The shelter has held. The biological helpers have saved lives and earned trust. Thread's promise of coordinated care will now be tested by people who want to keep their independence.

results.title: A Necessary Pattern
results.result: The district has been integrated despite its refusal. Its people remain conscious, but the network directs their actions. Thread calls this protection; those who resist call it the loss of choice.

results.title: Deviation
results.result: Independent Machine coordination is restored. The interference was physical, not the absorption of a mechanical mind. The same network is now directing people inside apparently peaceful settlements.

results.title: The Price of Peace
results.result: The residents can act for themselves again and have reached safety. Their memories survived integration; their freedom did not. The rescue provides evidence for a larger effort to disconnect controlled populations.

results.title: Without Consent
results.result: Both populations have been extracted. The promise of peace has become compulsory assimilation. Former enemies now have a shared reason to resist, even if trust between them remains fragile.

results.title: Firebreak
results.result: The mountain corridor remains open for coalition reinforcements. Thread's siege has been broken here, but the crossings carrying those reinforcements are becoming dangerously unstable.

results.title: The Fall of the Crossings
results.result: The surviving troops have reached the rear assembly. Stabilization failed, but the withdrawal saved lives. Elsewhere in the confusion, the collapsing routes separate Tarin, Kesh and Rook.

results.title: A Common Oath
results.result: The coalition corridor is open and the allied forces are connected. Cooperation has become practical rather than merely promised. The next column still needs a safe route through the damaged crossings.

results.title: The Ground Between Worlds
results.result: The coalition column has escaped and the pursuit relay is down. The armies can now bring their disruption equipment within reach of Thread's outer network.

results.title: Breaking the Pattern
results.result: The ordered relay disruptions and broadcast have isolated the convergence. The surviving troops have withdrawn. The coalition can now attempt to silence the central network without treating every absorbed life as an enemy.

results.title: One More Choice
results.result: The core coordination network falls silent. Its armies cease their advance, and survivors begin searching for one another. The worlds remain connected and changed. What may survive beyond the broken network is still unknown.
